title: Card Runs
commonMistakes: Forgetting the divisibility check before grouping
Starting runs at an arbitrary value rather than the smallest remaining one
Consuming only one run when the smallest value has several copies
Treating equal values as consecutive without checking gaps
followUps: How would you return one valid grouping rather than only deciding whether it exists?
What changes if a group may contain repeated values but must still be consecutive as a set?
How would you handle a stream of cards arriving one at a time?
attribution: Original problem by the Base Case contributors.
